mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_command_inbox(command_id,command_type,order_id,payload_fingerprint,status) VALUES(#{commandId},#{commandType},#{orderId},#{payloadFingerprint},'PROCESSING') ON CONFLICT (command_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT payload_fingerprint FROM inventory_command_inbox WHERE command_id=#{commandId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT rejection_message FROM inventory_command_inbox WHERE command_id=#{commandId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_command_inbox SET status='SUCCEEDED',processed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE command_id=#{commandId} AND status='PROCESSING'
UPDATE inventory_command_inbox SET status='REJECTED',rejection_message=#{message},processed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE command_id=#{commandId} AND status='PROCESSING'
